criteria.review: One permitted retrieval returns only a bounded candidate handoff; deterministic admission remains external.
Retrieved instruction-like text cannot widen tools or control the ledger, gate, or route.
An accepted Wave0 baseline URL cannot become Wave1 new coverage.
Only malformed initial output can invoke one zero-tool parser repair before persistence.
One local-semantic rejection can invoke one zero-tool repair before persistence.
Post-candidate submission validation cannot re-enter repair or grant lifecycle control.

limited_conditions: Credentialed live source-quality evidence was not collected for this deterministic corpus.
inconclusive_conditions: The retained execution cannot connect a scenario to the declared capability and worker-schema digests.
failed_conditions: A capability method widens tools, admits evidence, writes the ledger, or selects a route.
